environment.description: Same service deployed on ECS Fargate. The ALB listener is configured with mutual TLS authentication using a custom trust store (arn:aws:acm-pca:us-east-1:ACCOUNT:certificate-authority/CA_ID). The listener's MutualAuthentication attribute is set with Mode=verify, TrustStoreArn pointing to an ACM PCA-issued intermediate CA that only issues certificates to internal service mesh sidecars and corporate VPN endpoint clients. The trust store contains exactly 2 CA certificates: the internal mesh CA and the corporate endpoint CA. Connection attempts without a valid client certificate signed by one of these CAs receive a TLS handshake failure at the ALB layer (TCP RST before HTTP). The ALB access logs confirm that unauthenticated connections never produce a target request. Additionally, the ALB listener rule has a condition matching the X-Amzn-Mtls-Clientcert-Serial-Number header (populated by ALB after successful mTLS) against a DynamoDB-backed Lambda authorizer that validates the serial is in an active enrollment table, though this secondary check is informational only.

config.load_balancer: ALB with HTTPS:443 listener, MutualAuthentication Mode=verify, TrustStoreArn=arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-east-1:ACCOUNT:truststore/ts-0abc123def456
config.mtls_enforcement: verify mode - connection rejected at TLS layer without valid client cert
config.security_groups: ALB SG: inbound 443/tcp from 10.0.0.0/8 only; Task SG: inbound 4000/tcp from ALB SG only
config.network: Private subnet, LDAP server at directory.internal:389 reachable via VPC DNS
config.secondary_check: Lambda@Edge validates X-Amzn-Mtls-Clientcert-Serial-Number against enrollment DB (informational)
